notes.title: Version 2.0 Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’m excited to announce a major update to Hololive Room Visitor! This update introduces 5 brand-new rooms, each inspired by your favorite Hololive talents.

New Rooms:

Oozora Subaru
Kiryu Coco
Gawr Gura
Tsukumo Sana
Kureiji Ollie
Each room is uniquely designed to reflect the personality and themes of these Hololive talents. Additionally, Ollie’s room features a fun minigame for you to enjoy!

Explore the new rooms, immerse yourself in the world of Hololive, and experience these creative additions firsthand.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. I can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this update!

See you in VR!
